title: Check which CPU architectures a binary supports
summary: Use `lipo` to see if a program or library contains code for Intel (x86_64), Apple Silicon (arm64), or both. This helps you understand if an app is native to your Mac or running via translation.

aliases.text: is this app intel or apple silicon

steps.explain: Run `lipo` with the `-archs` flag on the binary file to list the CPU architectures it contains.

placeholders.name: BINARY_FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the executable or library file you want to inspect
